articles.title: Congressional hearing highlights military’s reliance on NOAA data
articles.summary:
SAN FRANCISCO – A Jan. 13 hearing underscored the importance of ongoing collaboration between the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) and the U.S. armed services. U.S. Air Force and U.S. Navy witnesses discussed their heavy reliance on datasets and weather models provided by NOAA and said their agencies are working closely to ensure NOAA’s […]

articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch midweek Starlink mission on Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral
articles.summary: The Starlink 6-98 mission will add 29 Starlink V2 Mini Optimized satellites to the low Earth orbit constellation. Liftoff from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for 1:08 p.m. EST (1808 UTC).

articles.title: U.S. Space Force switches rockets for upcoming GPS satellite launch
articles.summary: The change will allow the U.S. Space Force to expedite the process of building out its GPS constellation in medium Earth orbit. The launch date for the next satellite, GPS III Space Vehicle 09, could be within weeks.
